thread:
noah_cs: Heads up — Prospect: Meridian Health (EU) flagged our DPA during renewal pre-check. Their security lead insists on written confirmation that any embeddings derived from their PHI will never leave the EU. They said this is a blocker for the contract.

tara_se: Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? That will determine our remediation options.

noah_cs: Hosted trial. They're leaning toward Dedicated if we can give a region-lock guarantee + BYOK. They're also asking about retention windows for embeddings.

kevin_infra: Quick background: our Hosted offering supports tenant pinning to a region for active data and inference. However, certain internal snapshot/backup processes historically had optional cross-region replication for DR. We can disable replication per-tenant but need infra approval to ensure backups are kept in-region by policy.

jill_legal: Can we get Meridian to provide the exact contractual language they need? If they want an absolute prohibition on transfer, we need to carve out standard DR exceptions or offer Dedicated/Private as the sole path to that guarantee.

noah_cs: I've asked them to paste the clause. They responded with: "Supplier agrees that embeddings and any derived machine representations of Customer Data will be stored and processed solely within the European Economic Area (EEA) and will not be transferred outside the EEA under any circumstance."

kevin_infra: Oof — that's absolute. Options: (A) Hosted with in-region-only config + attestations/evidence (preferred by us), (B) Dedicated with BYOK & explicit in-region backups, (C) Private on-prem. We can't accept an unqualified "never under any circumstance" for Hosted if our platform-level DR ever requires cross-region failover without customer consent.

kevin_infra: Propose a technical template we can provide as evidence (I will export configs/logs):
```
tenant_config:
  tenant_id: meridian-001
  inference_region: eu-west-1
  storage_region: eu-west-1
  backups:
    enabled: true
    retention_days: 30
    replication: disabled
  kms: customer-byok-eu-1234
```

noah_cs: Good. Also need to capture retention policy + deletion flow for embeddings (they asked how to remove derived embeddings on termination).

jill_legal: Suggested contract wording draft for Hosted (limited wording): "Supplier shall, subject to the technical constraints described in the Technical Attachment, store and process Customer Data and Derived Data within the EEA. Disaster recovery processes that would transfer data outside the EEA will not be enabled for Customer's tenancy without Customer's prior written consent."

noah_cs: That sounds reasonable. Meridian also wants a short evidence packet: architecture diagram, storage KMS policy, recent config export showing replication disabled, and a log sample proving data residency for last 7 days.

kevin_infra: I'll pull a config export and a 7-day routing log slice. Will redact internal hostnames. Spinning a ticket with infra: INF-7891.

evidence-bot: Evidence request INF-7891 created. Attachments pending: tech-arch.pdf, config-export-5143219876.json, routing-sample-7d.csv. Link: https://internal.redwood/evidence/INF-7891

noah_cs: Great. Can we also provide an explicit retention/deletion workflow? Meridian wants to know how we delete embeddings on request.

kevin_infra: Retention/deletion notes: embeddings are purged from active DB within 24 hours of deletion request; snapshots may persist until retention window ends (<=30 days) unless we run a forced purge for the tenant. For Dedicated we can shorten retention to 0 days for snapshots. We'll include the deletion runbook steps.

jill_legal: I'll prepare a legal addendum that ties the technical attachment and the runbook to the DPA: short form: "Supplier's Technical Attachment and Runbook (attached) form part of the Agreement and describe the measures used to keep the Customer's data and Derived Data within the EEA; deviations require Customer consent."

noah_cs: Thanks all. I'm scheduling a 30-min call with Meridian sec and ops tomorrow at 10:00 CET to walk through the packet. I'll post the meeting invite and the evidence link. This is high renewal risk if we don't move fast.

kevin_infra: Export and logs posted to INF-7891 (evidence-bot link). Also flagged for SRE review to confirm no hidden replication jobs.

noah_cs: Filing a renewal risk flag: RISK-2026-meridian. If they require Dedicated, we'll fast-track an estimate.

jill_legal: If they accept the language above, we might avoid contract-level escalation. I'll standby to redline once the customer responds.

noah_cs: Posting evidence link to customer and closing internal loop once they confirm. Will update thread after the call. :white_check_mark:
